criteria.requirement: Closed evidence record that names one W02a record by schema version (planeon.internal.native-qualification/v3) and qualification digest ("sha256:" and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of W02a's canonical JSON form of the record, spelled as W02a captures spell qualificationDigest); W02a v3's check_record accepts that record; the evidence's implementationId and testOnly equal the record's backendProfile; a test-only backend qualifies only in an explicit fixture call, and the unit-distribution fixture identity never qualifies a production backend. The evidence is per record: combining it with check_qualification's acceptance of the same record is the caller's composition (W03)
criteria.source: W02a P7(a); W02g review N1; W02g-F review R1-5, R1-6

criteria.requirement: Datastore on AF_UNIX only, one member, no peers
Apiserver binds a loopback address

No anonymous, static-token, bootstrap-token, front-proxy request-header or external (JWT, webhook) authentication; service-account tokens signed in-process (no --service-account-signing-endpoint), the signing key readable by the apiserver only, the only verification key its public half, one fixed issuer and token lookup on; no cluster-admin credential, trusted CA private key or bootstrap token on the host
criteria.source: Spec P3, P4; W01 F1; kube-apiserver v1.37.1 options (pkg/controlplane/apiserver/options/options.go, pkg/kubeapiserver/options/authentication.go)

criteria.requirement: Authorization exactly Node then RBAC from a sealed structured configuration file (the binary default without flags is AlwaysAllow; the file is reloaded on change)

Required admission plugins enabled (NodeRestriction is off by default upstream); webhook admission, MutatingAdmissionPolicy, NamespaceAutoProvision, ImagePolicyWebhook and AlwaysAdmit disabled; nothing outside the allowed set
Per-controller credentials (upstream default off); only inventory controllers; every required-disabled controller off; no signing key in the controller-manager
Kubelet: no certificate rotation or TLS bootstrap, no static pod source (staticPodPath, staticPodURL and its header), no anonymous or read-only access, Webhook authorization
criteria.source: Spec 2.3, P4, P5, P9; KubeletConfiguration v1beta1 (staging/src/k8s.io/kubelet/config/v1beta1/types.go)

criteria.requirement: Exactly the W02a v3 record's backend components (six required, service proxy and network-policy agent optional), each a separate process in its W02a confined type, from a canonical executable path; W02a v3's backend rules hold because SC00 applies check_record: own domains and API identities; API identities within the W02g closure entry for each component, except that KUBELET may also hold at most one system:node:<node name> identity and APISERVER may hold none; owned, listed file paths; cgroups outside the planeon slice that are neither shared nor nested. Distinct executables with distinct content (one entry type per confined domain) is an I06 rule: W02a v3 lets backend components share code within its single backend owner class
criteria.source: W02a backend rules; W02g review N1, N3; W02g-F review R1-1, R1-3

criteria.requirement: Only local APIServices and no CustomResourceDefinitions
No automounted tokens; the only component API clients are the closure's service-proxy and network-policy-agent identities, for the components present
Container runtime socket reachable only from the kubelet's confined type

Sealed configuration is exactly the profile's file set: control-plane flags and configs, component definitions, kubeconfigs, PKI trust bundles, container runtime and CNI configuration, plus the authentication configuration, admission manifests, audit policy and optional component configuration when used; auto-apply manifest directories empty and sealed
Pinned, offline, license-allowed artifacts with no runtime downloads or auto-update
Kubernetes release exactly v1.37.1, the release this inventory and closure were derived from
Feature gates at their v1.37 defaults in every Kubernetes component; no emulated or minimum-compatibility version and no runtime-config

Closure derivation: upstream identities hold exactly their bootstrap-derived grants; the planeon identities are a closed set with fixed holders and grants (writer grants fixed by the model, the kubelet client's from system:kubelet-api-admin, none for the others); full authority only for system:masters; closure service accounts only for allowed controllers in kube-system
Every subject holding a policy write, status write, identity-acquisition or escalation verb, or a workload grant at cluster scope or in kube-system is a closure identity
Closure identities with grants exist; an absent controller account may carry only grants of its own bootstrap role (and of its closure entry)

No grant beyond the subject's closure entry; the loopback user system:apiserver holds no resource rule of any kind. The snapshot shape carries resource rules only, so an observer that finds a non-resource-URL rule bound to system:apiserver refuses to produce the snapshot (observer obligation, W03)
criteria.source: Spec 2.3; W01 F1; W02g review N2; W02g-F review R1-7

criteria.requirement: The policy writer's escalate and bind only on the named planeon Roles
Required closure identities present
An apiserver restart during ACTIVE invalidates the generation: bootstrap-roles and the system-namespace and authentication-info controllers write policy kinds at start
Policy-kind objects carry no ownerReferences, so the wildcard garbage collector cannot delete them; observer-checked
No ClusterRole with an aggregationRule is bound in the qualification namespace (the aggregation controller is disabled, so such roles keep stale rules)
API Priority and Fairness objects affect availability only; system:masters is exempt; only the in-process producer writes them
No Secret of type kubernetes.io/service-account-token and no bootstrap-token Secret exists; Secret reads then yield no credential; observer-checked
No ValidatingWebhookConfiguration, MutatingWebhookConfiguration or MutatingAdmissionPolicy(Binding) object exists, although their admission plugins are disabled; observer-checked
The observer starts INSPECTING only after /readyz/poststarthook/rbac/bootstrap-roles succeeds

Recommendation for W02f: hold the A2 admission policies in sealed file-based admission manifests (ManifestBasedAdmissionControlConfig, beta and default on in v1.37), because API-registered policies cannot guard admission objects
